title: Raspberry Cream Yogurt Pots
blurb: Layers of tangy Greek yogurt, lightly sweetened whipped cream and fresh raspberries make a simple breakfast or snack that feels a bit special.
steps: Pour the cream into a bowl, add half the vanilla extract and half the coconut sugar, then whisk until it holds soft peaks.
In another bowl, stir together the yogurt with the remaining vanilla and coconut sugar until smooth.
Lightly crush about half the raspberries with a fork, leaving the rest whole.
Divide half the yogurt mixture between four glasses or bowls, then add a layer of crushed raspberries.
Spoon the whipped cream over the raspberries, then top with the remaining yogurt.
Finish each pot with the whole raspberries arranged on top and serve straight away, or chill until needed.
